title: UPI Transaction Failure and Auto-Reversal Policy
content: When money is debited from the sender's bank account during a UPI transaction but the beneficiary does not receive the funds, NPCI guidelines mandate automatic reversal. Most failed UPI transactions auto-reverse within T+1 business day and at most within 3 to 5 working days. If the reversal is not credited after 3 working days, the customer should raise a transaction dispute inside the UPI app under Transaction History using the 12-digit UTR or RRN reference number, or contact customer support to log a reconciliation ticket.

title: UPI Daily Transfer Limits and Incorrect Beneficiary Policy
content: Standard peer-to-peer UPI transfers carry a daily limit of up to Rs 1,00,000 per 24 hours across up to 20 transactions, with a lower Rs 5,000 cap during the first 24 hours after resetting UPI MPIN or changing a SIM card. If funds were sent intentionally to an incorrect UPI ID, the bank cannot unilaterally reverse settled payments without beneficiary consent and recipient-bank recall mediation.

title: RBI and NPCI Compensation Policy for Delayed UPI Reversals
content: Under RBI Circular DPSS.CO.PD No.629/02.01.014/2019-20, if an account is debited in a failed UPI transaction and the funds are not reversed to the customer's account within T+1 business day, the issuing bank is liable to pay auto-compensation of ₹100 per day of delay directly credited to the customer's bank account without requiring a separate claim.

title: Resolving UPI Funds Transferred to Wrong Beneficiary or Mobile Number
content: If you transferred money to an unintended UPI ID or phone number: First, locate the 12-digit UTR number from your payment app. Second, contact your bank and lodge an unintended beneficiary dispute. The remitter bank sends an inter-bank recall request to the beneficiary's bank. If the beneficiary gives consent, funds are reversed within 7 business days. If the beneficiary refuses to return the money, the remitter can file a complaint with the cyber cell and Banking Ombudsman.

title: UPI Lite for PIN-less Small Value Offline Transactions
content: UPI Lite enables instant, PIN-less small-value payments up to ₹500 per transaction using an on-device digital wallet. The maximum wallet balance allowed at any time is ₹2,000, and total daily spend is capped at ₹4,000. UPI Lite transactions do not clutter your bank statement passbook (only top-ups appear) and have a near-100% success rate because they do not ping bank core banking servers during payment.

title: UPI AutoPay for Recurring Subscriptions and Mandate Cancellation
content: UPI AutoPay automates recurring payments for OTT subscriptions, mutual fund SIPs, mobile recharges, and loan EMIs. Mandates up to ₹15,000 are debited automatically without requiring an OTP or PIN on the scheduled due date. A pre-debit SMS notification is sent 24 hours prior to debit. Customers can modify, pause, or cancel any recurring mandate at any time directly inside their UPI app under 'AutoPay' or 'Mandates'.

title: UPI International QR Payments in Foreign Countries
content: Indian travelers can scan and pay via UPI QR codes at merchants abroad in supported countries including the UAE, Singapore, Nepal, Bhutan, Mauritius, Sri Lanka, and France. Users activate 'UPI International' inside their payment app before travel for a duration of up to 90 days. Transactions are debited from the domestic Indian rupee bank account in INR based on live foreign exchange conversion rates plus nominal bank forex markup.

title: Setting and Resetting UPI PIN Using Aadhaar OTP Verification
content: Customers who do not possess a physical debit card can set up or reset their UPI PIN using Aadhaar-based OTP authentication. Select 'Set UPI PIN with Aadhaar' in the UPI app, enter the first 6 digits of your Aadhaar card number, and verify with dual OTPs (one received from UIDAI and one received from the bank). This immediately enables full UPI payments without visiting a bank branch.

title: Fundamental UPI Security Rule: Never Enter PIN to Receive Money
content: A UPI PIN is strictly required only to DEBIT or transfer money out of your bank account. Receiving funds or refunds never requires entering a UPI PIN, scanning a QR code, or accepting a collect request. Beware of scammers sending 'Collect Requests' on PhonePe or Google Pay under the guise of paying refunds or rewards. Reject any unexpected collect requests immediately and report the VPA handle.

title: E-Commerce Merchant Refund Timelines via UPI and Chargebacks
content: When an order is cancelled or returned on e-commerce platforms (Amazon, Flipkart, Swiggy, IRCTC), refunds via UPI are initiated within 2 hours and credit to the source bank account within 24 hours. If the merchant confirms refund dispatch with an RRN number but your bank account does not reflect credit after 48 hours, raise a dispute using the 12-digit UTR on NPCI's Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) portal.

title: Category-Specific UPI Transaction Limits (IPO, Capital Markets, Hospitals)
content: While regular P2P (Person-to-Person) and P2M (Person-to-Merchant) transactions have a daily limit of ₹1,00,000, NPCI has authorized enhanced limits for specialized categories: Retail Direct government securities and IPO subscriptions have a limit of ₹5,00,000 per transaction; payments to approved hospitals and educational institutions also have an enhanced limit of ₹5,00,000 per transaction.

title: 24-Hour Cooling Period and ₹5,000 Transaction Cap on New Devices
content: As an anti-fraud safeguard against unauthorized device swaps and SIM cloning, when a customer sets up UPI on a new smartphone or resets their UPI PIN, a mandatory 24-hour cooling period is enforced. During these initial 24 hours, outgoing UPI transfers are capped at ₹5,000 or a maximum of one transaction. Normal limits resume automatically after 24 hours without customer action.

title: UPI Number Portability and Mobile Number as Universal UPI ID
content: Customers can map their 10-digit mobile number as their default UPI Number. Once registered in the NPCI central mapper, anyone can send money to your mobile number from any app (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm, BHIM) and it routes directly to your chosen primary bank account. You can switch your primary linked bank account anytime without changing your mobile number handle.

title: Lost Phone Emergency UPI Deactivation and Profile Deregistration
content: If your phone is lost or stolen, protect your bank accounts immediately: Step 1: Call your telecom operator to block your SIM card to stop OTP interception. Step 2: Call the bank 24x7 helpline to deregister your UPI profile and freeze mobile banking. Step 3: Google Find My Device or Apple iCloud can be used to perform remote wipe of sensitive payment data.

title: Common UPI Error Codes (U16, U30, U69, Z9) and Solutions
content: Common UPI error codes: 'U16 - Risk Threshold Exceeded' means daily frequency or amount limit has been breached; try tomorrow or split amount. 'U30 - Bank Server Down' means remitter or beneficiary core banking is undergoing maintenance; retry after 30 minutes. 'U69 - Incorrect PIN' means 3 wrong attempts were made; account is locked for 24 hours. 'Z9 - Insufficient Funds' indicates inadequate available balance.
